summary.oneLiner: Birla Cable Limited manufactures and sells Optical Fibre Cables, Copper Telecommunication Cables, Structured Copper LAN Cables, Specialty cables and allied accessories for India's telecom and enterprise networking infrastructure.
summary.business: The Company's main business activities are manufacturing and sales of all types of Optical Fibre Cables, Copper Telecommunication Cables, Structured Copper LAN Cables, Specialty cables and allied accessories. It serves telecom operators and enterprise customers in both domestic and export markets, with the Structured Copper LAN Cable segment recently becoming the dominant revenue driver while the Optical Fibre Cable business navigates a prolonged industry downturn.

Separately, the Board approved a Scheme of Amalgamation with Vindhya Telelinks Limited (appointed date April 1, 2026) intended, among other things, to consolidate the manufacturing capabilities and capacities of both companies into a larger unified entity with enhanced market presence and improved competitive positioning for larger, capital-intensive multi-state infrastructure projects.

risks.risk: Structural technology substitution away from copper cables
risks.note: All telecom operators are increasingly going for optical fibre cables, meaning traditional copper telecommunication cable requirements in the network are no longer required, structurally reducing that product line's addressable demand.
Cut-throat competition is described as the norm in the cable industry, with some players offering highly advantageous price levels that bring margins under huge pressure.
Players offering products with inferior technology can affect network standards, pulling the industry away from international benchmarks.
The Company flags a highly concentrated customer base as a financial risk; credit risk could increase if the financial condition of the Company's customers declines.
Adverse movements in raw material prices are cited among the Company's financial risks, which can compress margins given input-cost sensitivity.
The Company is exposed to foreign exchange volatility and related exchange-rate fluctuations, relevant given its export sales of Optical Fibre Cables.

risks.risk: Low capacity utilisation and un-remunerative pricing
risks.note: Financial risks explicitly include low-capacity utilisation and un-remunerative prices, alongside shorter delivery schedules and exposure to liquidated damages.
Sourcing raw materials and distributing finished products face logistics bottlenecks; recent geopolitical disturbances and rising transportation costs have further intensified this challenge.
